# SSE Practice Project - AI Coding Guide

## Project Overview

This is a practice project focused on Server-Sent Events (SSE) implementation with a backend/frontend architecture. The project uses conda for Python environment management.

## Architecture

- **Backend**: Python-based server implementing SSE endpoints
- **Frontend**: Client application consuming SSE streams
- **Environment**: Uses conda environment named `sse` for Python dependencies

## Development Setup

```bash
# Activate the conda environment
conda activate sse

# Navigate to project root
cd /Users/lsh/sse-practice
```
